episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Neve Kelly discovers that she is dead and understandably is scared and confused by this new stare, but when she realises she has been murdered, she is furious. Determined to find her killer and get justice, she takes advantage of her new supernatural abilities to go where the police can't and investigate her own death.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After a shocking revelation, Neve and her father Tom try to process her new reality. Neve herself starts to follow her own murder investigation.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Suspicions grow regarding Neve's ex-boyfriend Joseph and what part he may have had to play in her death. The family attend the vigil for Neve, whilst Alex questions Neve's stepsister.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As Neve pursues a connection in the woods, a supernatural breakthrough leads to some disturbing revelations.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Terrified, and sure she knows who her killer is, Neve seeks help from Alex, whose mother and father are beginning to show concern.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Budding relationships falter and old ones have the potential to rekindle as Neve and Alex fall out.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: It's seven years earlier and the last day of Victoria Sand's life. She and a young Katie and Max surprise Daniel for his birthday.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Everything comes to a head at Keaton Hall, and Neve and Alex must fight their way back to each other. Series finale.
